content: NIP-09 deletion is a request and cannot guarantee deletion across all relays/clients; relays should retain the deletion request. NIP-62 asks target relays to fully delete a key history. Current Pyramid rejects kind-5 deletion of group messages older than two hours and soft-deletes entire groups into a root-visible archive, conflicting with the project deletion promise unless changed and tested. Backups need bounded expiry and restore-time tombstone enforcement.
